THE PERSON BEHIND THE PLANS↗

02 A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curious by nature.
Intentional by design.

Hi, I’m Kollene. I believe architecture begins with understanding how people live.

I’m a fourth-year Bachelor of Science in Architecture student at Mapúa University. My academic journey explores residential, commercial, civic, and public spaces through plans, visualizations, and hands-on making.

I’m drawn to design that brings functionality, beauty, and sustainability together. For me, a meaningful space responds to its surroundings and makes room for the people who use it.
